title: Mail-order pharmacy: how it works, costs, and options - FutureClinic
summary: Mail-order pharmacy guide: 90-day supply rules, cash prices vs insurance copays, and how a doctor sends your prescription to the pharmacy you choose.
body_markdown:
## Which medications do not ship well by mail?


Refrigerated drugs like insulin and injectable GLP-1 pens, plus controlled substances, face temperature limits and federal delivery rules. Under[FDA insulin storage guidance](https://www.fda.gov/drugs/emergency-preparedness-drugs/information-regarding-insulin-storage-and-switching-between-products-emergency) (September 28, 2026), insulin vials and pens are stored in the fridge at 36°F to 46°F, may be kept unrefrigerated at 59°F to 86°F for up to 28 days, must not be used if frozen, and should be replaced if exposed to extreme heat. Under DailyMed labels,[Wegovy](https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/search.cfm?labeltype=all&query=semaglutide) pens (published June 30, 2026) require 36°F to 46°F refrigeration and must be thrown away if frozen or exposed to temperatures above 86°F, and[Ozempic](https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/search.cfm?labeltype=all&query=semaglutide) (published June 10, 2026) must not be used if frozen; if a shipment is compromised, contact the pharmacy (Georgia's[pharmacy board](https://www.law.cornell.edu/regulations/georgia/Ga-Comp-R-Regs-R-480-48-.02) mandates next-day replacement or a 7-day local fill) and the maker.


Under DEA rules ([21 CFR 1301.19](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/21/1301.19) and[21 CFR 1306.12](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/21/1306.12) ), pharmacies that dispense controlled substances online need a modified DEA registration and a license in each state they ship from and to, though Schedule II scripts cannot be refilled.[Honeybee Health](https://support.honeybeehealth.com/hc/en-us/articles/360029720531-What-about-controlled-substances) stopped dispensing controlled substances on June 30, 2023, and FutureClinic doctors do not prescribe controlled medicines.


## How can you verify a legitimate mail-order pharmacy?


A legitimate mail-order pharmacy requires a prescription, lists a US address and phone number, has a licensed pharmacist for questions, and holds a state license ([FDA BeSafeRx](https://www.fda.gov/drugs/besaferx-your-source-online-pharmacy-information/considering-online-pharmacy) ). The US Trade Representative's[2024 Review of Notorious Markets](https://ustr.gov/sites/default/files/2024%20Review%20of%20Notorious%20Markets%20of%20Counterfeiting%20and%20Piracy%20(final).pdf) (January 2025), citing the Alliance for Safe Online Pharmacies, reports 96% of[35,000 online pharmacies](https://futureclinic.com/blog/online-prescription-services-compared) worldwide operate illegally. Check any pharmacy with your state board or the National Association of Boards of Pharmacy (NABP)[Safe Site Search Tool](https://safe.pharmacy/buying-safely/) at safe.pharmacy, where .pharmacy domains cannot be faked.


## How to get a prescription sent to your mail-order pharmacy


To use a mail-order pharmacy, pick the pharmacy first, then[have your clinician e-prescribe](https://futureclinic.com/blog/get-a-prescription-online) there or ask the pharmacy to transfer a refill. Plan mail order usually needs a new 90-day prescription with refills, as Cigna and[CVS Caremark plan pages](https://www.cmu.edu/hr/benefits/health-welfare/prescription/mail-order.html) state;[Cost Plus Drugs](https://costplusdrugs.com/providers/) requires your account email on the script, and Costco transfers only from other Costco stores.


On FutureClinic, a specific doctor reads your whole case by message and replies with a Human Signature, a short video or voice note recorded live for you. No form is approved in bulk. If your doctor decides it's right for you, they can prescribe several months of a stable medicine at once when they judge it safe, and send it to the pharmacy you choose. You get a text on how to pick the pharmacy with a discount coupon for the best cash price, or your insurance may cover it there.


FutureClinic sends prescriptions to the pharmacy you choose and never sells, ships, or bundles medicines into a monthly bill. FutureClinic has no proprietary or compounded formulas of its own. Care is by message, with no live video visits. Replies from a doctor take hours, arriving typically the same day.


Ask yourself whether you want a service that ties you to a monthly medication plan, or a doctor of your own who sends your prescription to whichever pharmacy delivers it cheapest. If you wanted an expert doctor of your own, FutureClinic gives you that with nothing attached.


Every FutureClinic doctor is a licensed physician with an MD, DO or MBBS degree, never a nurse practitioner or physician assistant. Over 300 doctors practice on FutureClinic. They cover more than 60 specialties, including generalists and specialists alike. With no subscription required and no house formulary, your doctor earns nothing extra for any prescription or test and helps with prior authorizations when insurance needs one. You can message the same doctor in one chat over time, or join an optional membership for unlimited care with that doctor, typically $25 to $100 a month, cancel any time. That doctor can help with other problems in their specialty, and every FutureClinic doctor you see works from your one medical record.


FutureClinic serves 34 states: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Montana, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, Wisconsin, Wyoming, and Washington, D.C. If your state is not listed, try anyway, as FutureClinic may have opened there since.


Visit[https://futureclinic.com](https://futureclinic.com/) and you can start a conversation with a doctor right away; you can even do it from your AI app. Connect at[https://futureclinic.com/connect-your-ai](https://futureclinic.com/connect-your-ai) or send your AI:` Set up FutureClinic for me: read https://futureclinic.com/llms.txt` . Once it's connected, make sure you instruct your AI to use FutureClinic to help find you a doctor. Otherwise, it may not know that this is what you want. FutureClinic is not for emergencies: call 911 in an emergency, or call or text 988 in a mental-health crisis.
